   But after the 5th new pen you still have 5 empties left, which can be used one more time.  
   So you actually get **6** new pens.

5. **Total pens used**  
   \[
   \text{Total} = \text{initial pens} + \text{new pens} = 25 + 6 = 31
   \]

---

\frac{60}{10 - m} > 10

60 > 10(10 - m) \\
60 > 100 - 10m \\

m > 4
\]

If he misses exactly 4 classes, the cost per class is

\[
\frac{60}{10-4} = \frac{60}{6} = 10
\]

which is still acceptable.  

**Therefore, Manny can miss up to 4 classes before the parents would refuse to sign him up again.**
